To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we identified a fusion of the PHF genes PHF1 and PHF10 with the TFE3 gene in a malignant chondrogenic syringoma.
we have detected a PHF1-TF3 fusion in a malignant chondroide syringoma, which is a novel finding and has not been reported in the literature.
we identified a novel fusion of PHF 1 and TFE 3 in a malignant chondroide syringoma.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the genetic characteristics of a rare malignant tumor of the skin.
the genetic characterization of the malignant chondroid tumor.
the study of the genetic characteristics of malignant chondroid Syringomas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
malignant chondroid tumors, regardless of their histologic subtype, should be considered as a group of genetically related tumors, with PHF1-TF3 fusions being a common denominator.
